name: Squad AI
description:
It's easier than ever to build, which means building in the wrong direction faster. Squad is the decision intelligence layer for product teams. It finds the signal in the noise of your feedback and keeps it connected to the decisions it justifies, so you ship the right things.

Squad runs a team of always-on agents that continuously research and read your feedback sources, identify signals and insights, and recommend actions that support your goals. By the time you ask a question, the evidence is already organised. Every action points back to the insight and the signals behind it, so "why is this on the roadmap?" has an answer with receipts.

Underneath it all is an evergreen knowledge base: a living memory of your product and company context that stays current as new evidence lands, with an auditable trail behind every change. Claude reads from it and adds to it, so it works from what your team knows, not a blank slate each session.

This connector brings that intelligence into Claude:
• Ground a decision. Pull the exact customer signals behind any insight or action before you build.
• Triage feedback. Capture a ticket or interview note as a signal, deduped against existing themes.
• Weekly review. Ask what changed, what the evidence says, and what needs deciding.
• Draft a one-pager. Generate a one-page decision brief from an action or insight.
• Search everything. Semantic search across signals, insights, actions, goals, and documents.

Every entity has a short display ID such as SI-1, IN-42, or AC-12, so Claude can cite the exact evidence behind its findings.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Squad AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Squad AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.meetsquad.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Squad AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Squad AI lists 32 MCP tools, including create_document, create_goal, create_research_question, dismiss_signal, find_similar_signals, generate_one_pager, get_action_context, get_activity, get_cluster, get_entity, get_workspace_overview, and ingest_signal.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Squad AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Squad AI in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Squad AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Squad AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Squad AI is developed by Squad AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
